title: Primary backup vault outage during database failure
narrative: A storage-controller fault at 08:20 UTC takes down both production databases. The same fault makes the primary backup vault unreachable. Recovery has to use the daily copies in the isolated recovery vault.

injections.description: Primary vault unreachable due to shared storage-controller failure.
Database volumes lost in the storage failure.

recommended_actions: Restore databases from the isolated vault
Separate primary vault storage from production storage
